content.user_title: Build Azure Translation Clients in TypeScript
content.value_statement: Developers need clear examples for Azure text and document translation in TypeScript. This skill provides REST client setup, authentication, translation flows, status checks, and best practices.
actual_capabilities: Shows package installation for Azure text and document translation clients.
Explains API key, region, endpoint, and DefaultAzureCredential authentication options.
Provides examples for text translation, transliteration, language detection, and supported languages.
Covers single document and batch document translation workflows.
Shows status checks, pagination, and supported document format lookup.
Summarizes key TypeScript types and Azure translation best practices.
limitations: Does not create Azure resources, subscriptions, credentials, or storage containers.
Does not run code, call Azure services, or validate account configuration.
Examples may need changes for package versions, regions, and tenant policies.
Batch document translation requires valid Blob Storage containers and SAS permissions.

use_cases.title: Add Product Text Translation
use_cases.description: Use text translation examples to localize short interface strings or support content.

use_cases.title: Translate Business Documents
use_cases.description: Use document translation flows for single files or container-based batch jobs.

use_cases.title: Plan Localization Support
use_cases.description: Review language, transliteration, detection, and format examples before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Text Translation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a TypeScript project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to configure Azure AI text translation in TypeScript using an endpoint, region, and subscription key.

prompt_templates.title: Translate Multiple Targets
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me translate one English text input into Spanish, French, and German with the Azure REST text client.

prompt_templates.title: Build Document Translation
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through single document translation in TypeScript, including authentication, request setup, and saving the translated file.

prompt_templates.title: Design Batch Translation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a batch document translation flow with source and target Blob Storage containers, SAS permissions, status checks, and pagination.

output_examples.input: I need to translate customer support text from English into Spanish and French.
output: Recommended client setup with endpoint, key, and region variables.
A translation request structure for one input and two target languages.
Error handling guidance using the Azure REST helper.

output_examples.input: I need to translate a file and save the translated result locally.
output: A single document translation workflow using multipart form data.
Target and optional source language guidance.
A save step for the returned translated stream.

output_examples.input: I need to monitor a batch document translation job.
output: A status check flow using the operation identifier.
Summary fields to inspect for totals and successes.

best_practices: Store subscription keys in environment variables or a managed secret store.
Use time-limited SAS URLs with only the permissions each container needs.
Check unexpected responses before reading response bodies or status details.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode real subscription keys in source files or prompts.
Do not grant broad SAS permissions when read or write scope is enough.
Do not assume examples are production-ready without regional and tenant testing.

faq.question: Does this skill call Azure services directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides TypeScript examples and guidance for using Azure translation clients.

faq.question: Which Azure translation areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers text translation, transliteration, language detection, single document translation, and batch document translation.

faq.question: Does it support managed identity?
faq.answer: Yes. The document translation examples include DefaultAzureCredential for token-based authentication.

faq.question: Can I use it for batch translation?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains batch jobs that use source and target Blob Storage containers with SAS URLs.

faq.question: Does it validate my Azure region or endpoint?
faq.answer: No. You must verify endpoint, region, permissions, and package versions in your environment.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production code?
faq.answer: Use it as implementation guidance, then add logging, retries, monitoring, and security review before production use.
